💡 ffmpeg-skill | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: To empower AI coding agents with a comprehensive, local video editing capability, allowing them to process and manipulate video files directly without external dependencies or data uploads.
✨ Key Features: • 42 FFmpeg tools for video editing (cut, captions, reframe, loudness, etc.)
📖 Summary: ffmpeg-skill provides a local, offline video editing environment for AI coding agents like Claude Code and Cursor. It offers 42 FFmpeg-based tools accessible via a machine-readable contract and an MCP server, enabling agents to perform tasks such as cutting, adding captions, reframing, and loudness normalization without relying on cloud services or API keys.
